thread:
Zoe Tan: Heads up — found a small but reproducible bug in docs SDK snippet for region-routing. When customers pass country code `UK` the sample picks `us-west` endpoint instead of EU. Repro steps below.

Zoe Tan: curl example:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "X-Country: UK" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-rl","input":"hi"}'
```

Zoe Tan: In the JS SDK sample we show `country: 'UK'` and later map `country.toLowerCase()` which doesn't match our country-to-region lookup that expects `GB`.

Mike R: oof. good catch. Is this only in the quickstart or also in region routing page?

Zoe Tan: just spotted in quickstart and SDK examples under /docs/sdks/node. Also appears in the cURL snippet in localization guide.

Anya Patel: FYI int'l team — policy says canonical code is `GB`. We should mention both in text and normalize in samples. Also add a footnote about legacy `UK` tokens.

Luis (intl): Agree. We should add a normalization table and example code: `{'UK': 'GB'}`.

Samir (sdk): I can patch the JS snippet to run a normalizeCountry helper. Proposed code:
```
function normalizeCountry(c){
  return (c||'').toUpperCase() === 'UK' ? 'GB' : (c||'').toUpperCase();
}
const res = client.generate({country: normalizeCountry(country)});
```

Elena (platform): Also check metric tagging: if people pass unknown codes we fall back to `us` and that skews region metrics. We should log a warning in SDKs.

Zoe Tan: Plan: I'll open a docs PR to update quickstart text + cURL. Samir — can you open an SDK PR to add helper + unit test? Anya/Luis can add wording for residency note.

Samir (sdk): Yep, will open PR against `sdk-node` and link it here. ETA EOD.

Anya Patel: I'll write the copy and add a tiny footnote about `UK -> GB` and legal residency mapping. Ping me for review.

Mike R: Optional: add a lint rule in docs CI to catch raw `UK` or other non-ISO codes in snippets.

Zoe Tan: good idea. I'll add a quick grep job in docs CI as a follow-up issue.

docs-bot: New issue created — #4521: docs: normalize country codes in snippets (zoe)

Zoe Tan: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/786 — updates quickstart and cURL examples (:rocket:)

Samir (sdk): SDK PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/341 — adds normalizeCountry + test (:white_check_mark:)

Anya Patel: LGTM, added copy in PR review.

Mike R: Thanks everyone. Moving to review & merge. :thumbsup:
